name: Ana Clara Ribeiro da Silva
title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
summary: Highly accomplished Senior Digital Marketing Manager with 10+ years of experience in developing and executing comprehensive digital strategies for leading consumer brands. Proven track record in driving significant ROI through SEO, SEM, social media, and content marketing initiatives, consistently exceeding performance targets.

bullets: Led the digital marketing team in developing and executing strategies that increased online revenue by 28% year-over-year.
Optimized SEO performance, resulting in a 45% increase in organic traffic and a 15% reduction in customer acquisition cost (CAC).
Managed an annual marketing budget of R$2.5M, achieving an average ROI of 4:1 across all digital campaigns.
Implemented a new marketing automation platform, improving lead nurturing efficiency by 30% and reducing manual tasks by 20 hours/month.
Developed and managed integrated digital campaigns across multiple channels (SEM, social, display), boosting brand awareness by 35% for key clients.
Grew social media engagement rates by an average of 25% across 5 major client accounts through data-driven content strategies.
Improved website conversion rates by 18% through A/B testing and user experience optimizations.
Executed SEO and SEM campaigns, increasing qualified leads by 20% for e-commerce clients.
Monitored and reported on campaign performance using Google Analytics, providing actionable insights for optimization.
Assisted in content creation and distribution strategies, contributing to a 10% growth in blog traffic.
